description: The Argentine consulate that serves a city abroad (address, phone, email, website, opening hours) and how to do its procedures step by step: book an appointment, renew the national ID (DNI) and passport, vote from abroad, and register the citizenship of children born abroad. Each procedure includes the official source and the date it was reviewed. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it); the steps come as published, in Spanish.

city.description: The city: its slug from list_cities (madrid, new-york…), its name in Spanish, English or Italian (Madrid, New York, London, Londra…) or one of its airport codes (MAD, JFK).

lang.description: Language of the labels and of the text summary: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

topic.description: Only one procedure: appointment, id-card (DNI and passport), voting or citizenship. Omit for all.

name: consulate_info
title: Argentine consulate procedures
